Card Q&A.q: Is a "while your opponent has no Digimon with XX" condition also met when my opponent has no Digimon?

Effect: [When Digivolving] If you don't have [Ruli Tsukiyono], you may play 1 [Ruli Tsukiyono] from your hand without paying the cost.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] While your opponent has no unsuspended Digimon, this Digimon gets +1000 DP.
